title: Fix Amber login and relax team reads for members
body:
## Summary
- Added explicit signer-session handling for NIP-07, Amber/NIP-55, and `bunker://` NIP-46 flows in the web app.
- Fixed Amber return handling so it can recover the signed result from clipboard or a manual paste prompt instead of dropping the user back into a dead end.
- Changed team detail access to allow team members to read their team while keeping mutations and secret-bearing routes admin-only.
- Updated the team page UI and docs to match the new auth model.

## Testing
- `cargo test --workspace`
- `cd web && bun test`
- `cd web && bun run check`
- `cd web && bun run build`
- Local HTTP smoke check against the running dev server returned `200 OK` with the expected security headers.

title: [codex] Add remote signer sign-in options
body:
## Summary

- Adds a sign-in chooser for browser extension, NIP-46 remote signer, and Amber/NIP-55 flows.
- Uses Applesauce signers as the common auth primitive so extension, Nostr Connect, and Amber can all feed the existing NIP-98 API auth path.
- Adds NIP-46 bunker URL support plus generated `nostrconnect://` links requesting `get_public_key` and `sign_event:27235`.
- Keeps pubkey mismatch checks around signed NIP-98 events and clears active signer state on sign-out or allowlist failure.

## Validation

- `cd web && bun test`
- `cd web && bun run check`
- `cd web && bun run build`
- `git diff --check`
- Browser smoke test at `http://127.0.0.1:5173/`: opened the sign-in dialog, generated a Nostr Connect link, cancelled the pending session, and checked console warnings/errors.

title: Replace NDK with Applesauce and fix local Nostr auth/runtime defaults
body:
## Summary
- Swap the web app from NDK to Applesauce for signer access, profile/contact reads, and NIP-98 request signing.
- Fix profile/team image loading by allowing safe remote image URLs and tightening the image handling helpers.
- Remove dead relay defaults and standardize Nostr read/outbox/authorization relays around the current live relays.
- Fix local dev auth/CSP issues so the app can sign in and talk to the API on localhost without tripping CSP or port conflicts.
- Keep stored private keys encrypted at rest with the existing file-backed AES-GCM key manager, and document the operational tradeoffs.
- Refresh README/AUDIT notes to match the new runtime and security posture.

## Testing
- `bun test` and `bun run check` passed in `web/`.
- `bun run build` passed in `web/`.
- Local browser/server smoke testing confirmed CSP headers, redirect behavior, and successful team creation against the local API.
- Verified the NIP-98 team-creation flow succeeds end to end and the new team appears immediately in the UI.

title: Fix CSP handling so login pages keep SvelteKit inline script support
body:
## Summary
- Move CSP directive definition into `svelte.config.js` so SvelteKit can attach the nonce/hash sources it needs for inline bootstrap scripts.
- Stop overwriting `Content-Security-Policy` in the server hook when SvelteKit has already generated one.
- Keep a fallback CSP for responses that do not get a framework-generated policy, and add regression coverage for both cases.

## Testing
- `cd web && bun test`
- `cd web && bun run check`
- `cd web && bun run build`
- Local browser smoke test against the built app confirmed the login page renders and the response CSP includes a nonce on HTML pages.

title: [codex] Publish reusable Docker image
body:
## Summary
- publish one reusable GHCR image for API, web, and signer on every master push
- add docker-compose.prod.yml so servers can pull images instead of building Rust and Bun locally
- change the browser allowlist gate to ask /api/config?pubkey=<hex> for a boolean decision without exposing the full ALLOWED_PUBKEYS list
- keep API ALLOWED_PUBKEYS enforcement as the security boundary and remove the API VITE_ALLOWED_PUBKEYS fallback
- load the image in CI, smoke-test API and web health, then push the GHCR tags
- update deployment docs, init output, and upgrade notes for pull-based releases

## Validation
- cargo fmt --check
- cargo check -p keycast_api
- cargo test -p keycast_api
- cd web && bun test
- cd web && bun run check
- cd web && bun run build
- docker compose config

title: [codex] Harden Keycast runtime and upgrade path
body:
## Summary

- replace dead Nostr login plumbing with raw NIP-07 extension login helpers and server-side pubkey allowlist enforcement
- harden NIP-98 API authentication by validating URL, method, timestamp, body payload hash, and exact pubkey allowlist matches
- tighten permission config validation across Rust and Svelte, including `allowed_kinds`, content filters, and encrypt-to-self behavior
- add migration `0002_normalize_allowed_kinds_permissions.sql` plus live-upgrade docs and preflight checks for existing SQLite deployments
- harden Docker/runtime deployment with non-root users, read-only root filesystems, mounted `master.key`, lockfile-frozen builds, and Socket/Bun scan config
- add repo/package AGENTS.md guidance with CLAUDE.md symlinks and refresh README/AUDIT/UPGRADE docs
- expand Rust and web tests around auth, authorization, policy/team isolation, route protection, permissions, and migration compatibility

## Upgrade impact

This is a major deploy for existing installs. The migration normalizes old `allowed_kinds` permission JSON from `{ "sign": [...] }` to `{ "allowed_kinds": [...] }`; it does not rotate keys, change stored-key ciphertext, or invalidate existing bunker secrets. Existing deployments must preserve the current `master.key`, take a WAL-safe SQLite backup, fix host file ownership for the new non-root containers, and set `ALLOWED_PUBKEYS` before starting the hardened API.

## Validation

- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo check --workspace`
- `cargo test --workspace`
- `cd web && bun test`
- `cd web && bun run check`
- `cd web && bun run build`
- `bash -n scripts/upgrade_preflight.sh scripts/docker-entrypoint.sh scripts/init.sh scripts/healthcheck.sh`
- `cargo audit`
- `bun audit`
- `cd web && bun audit`
- `bun pm scan`
- `cd web && bun pm scan`
- `cd web && bun pm untrusted`
- `DOMAIN=example.com ALLOWED_PUBKEYS=<hex> docker compose config`

## Notes

Opened as draft because the real production/Caddy deployment still needs a live preflight run and staged upgrade rehearsal against the existing host files.
